qa/wave20-rtf-out.rtf.json: 1
`16-16`: **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Replace the `\\u` marker. It always matches, so it checks nothing.** Every RTF file that the writer emits has `\uc1` in its header. `"\\u"` is a substring of `\uc1`, `\ul` and `\ulnone`. The marker passes even when the writer never escapes non-ASCII text. The playbook has Arabic text (`مرحبا`), so use a code point from that text. The first letter is U+0645, which is `\u1605`.
Proposed fix ```diff - "\\u", + "\\u1605", ```

Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Review comments at @qa/check_wave20_rtf_out.py: - Around line 251-262: Update the soffice argument list in the RTF conversion flow to use an isolated user profile under out_dir, along with the required headless startup options, before --convert-to. Match the established convert() behavior so concurrent runs and unavailable default HOME profiles do not interfere. Review comments at @src/core/Epub.cpp: - Around line 962-986: Normalize heading levels in the nav TOC construction before calling writeTocOl: copy heads, derive the minimum level as the base, and clamp each subsequent level to no more than the previous normalized level plus one while preserving the base as the minimum. Pass the normalized collection and base level to writeTocOl so all headings are emitted and nested lists remain valid. - Around line 846-848: Update the note-writing flow centered on WriteCtx, writeRuns, writeNotes, and saveEpub to track note IDs in first-use order via a separate QStringList. Have writeNotes iterate that list by index and copy each note’s use vector before calling writeRuns, so nested note discovery can safely append IDs without invalidating QHash iteration; update key and value accesses to use the recorded note ID and copied vector. - Around line 44-48: Update isBcp47 and usableLang to normalize underscores to hyphens before validation and accept singleton-based extension or private-use subtags with their required following subtags. In saveEpub, validate and normalize primaryRaw through usableLang with the existing pt-PT fallback, rather than checking isBcp47 directly, while preserving valid language values for writeRuns. Review comments at @src/core/Odf.cpp: - Around line 776-784: In saveOdt, bound table column spans and accumulated row widths before generating table-column XML: define a 1024-column limit, reject any normalized cell.colSpan above it or any row sum that would exceed it, set the existing error output to “table has too many columns” when available, and return false. Preserve normal colCount calculation for valid rows. Review comments at @src/core/Preview.cpp: - Around line 2712-2747: Update renderBlockPng to render a copy of the block with caption and captionRuns cleared, passing that copy to paintFigureMarker so image captions are not embedded in the raster. For image blocks without an explicit height, derive hmm from loadBlockImage’s dimensions and the normalized 90/270-degree rotation state, preserving the existing bottom box reservation; leave explicit heights and non-image behavior unchanged. Review comments at @src/core/RtfReader.cpp: - Around line 1675-1697: The footnote resolution path rescans the entire document for each note, causing quadratic work. Replace finishNote()’s countNotes() call with a running footnote counter, record the doc_.body index before each flush, and update replaceNoteId() to scan only newly added blocks plus bodyRuns_, rowCells_, and table_; preserve note marker replacement while avoiding unrelated document scans. Review comments at @src/core/RtfWriter.cpp: - Line 169: Update the Unicode escape formatting in escapeText to cast each UTF-16 code unit to qint16 before converting it to int, so RTF \u values use the required signed 16-bit range while preserving the existing fallback character. - Line 576: Update paraProps so the inTable branch emits \pard\intbl instead of only \intbl, ensuring every table cell resets inherited paragraph properties while preserving the existing non-table \pard behavior. - Around line 312-332: Update emitRun to handle runs with an empty field and non-empty link before the existing field check, emitting an RTF HYPERLINK field using r.link as the target and r.text (falling back to r.link) as the display text while preserving character properties. Keep the existing nativeFieldInstr and plain-text paths unchanged. - Line 459: Ensure collectFontsColors registers Liberation Serif before scanning document styles and runs, or update the RTF header to emit the computed defaultFont index instead of hardcoding \deff0; keep charProps default-font handling consistent with that index. - Line 620: Update the table output in RtfWriter so closing a table does not create an empty paragraph on round trips: replace the trailing `\pard\par` sequence in the `emitTable(b)` path with the minimal closing control needed, while preserving table termination and existing paragraph behavior elsewhere. - Around line 431-435: Update the image export block in RtfWriter to detect JPEG data via imageMime or FF D8 magic bytes and emit the matching blip type, obtain source pixel dimensions with QImage::fromData(bytes).size(), and write those dimensions to picw/pich. Store display dimensions in picwgoal/pichgoal, deriving the goal height from the image aspect ratio instead of forcing a square output. Review comments at @src/core/Session.cpp: - Around line 233-234: Update saveDocument and the EPUB branch around saveEpub so EPUB export does not replace the editable document path or clear its dirty state. Keep the existing document save path and unsaved status intact when the requested extension is epub, and ensure subsequent saves continue targeting a supported editable format. - Line 240: Update Session::saveTo() to collect warnings from saveRtf by passing a QStringList, then add any non-empty warnings to exportInfo as a QJsonArray under the "warnings" key while preserving the existing failure return behavior. Review comments at @src/mcp/ToolDispatch.cpp: - Line 56: Update the saveEpub description in ToolDispatch so EPUB content is described as split at Heading 1 boundaries, with optional front matter for content before the first Heading 1 and a single file when no Heading 1 exists; keep the documented format, return fields, and unsupported-import statement consistent with the implementation. --- Nitpick comments: Review comments at @qa/wave20-rtf-out.rtf.json: - Line 16: Replace the "\\u" marker in the expected RTF output fixture with "\\u1605", using the U+0645 escape for the first Arabic character so the assertion verifies non-ASCII escaping.
